name: fallout-chatmod-cross-platform-overlay
description: Cross-platform (Windows/macOS/Linux) Electron overlay that mounts the live ChatOverlay React component and feeds it data from the production relay.

scripts.start:local: cross-env RELAY_HTTP=http://localhost:7076 RELAY_WS=ws://localhost:7076/ws npm run start
scripts.predev:local: powershell -Command "Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5290 -EA SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -Force -EA SilentlyContinue }; exit 0"
scripts.dev:local: concurrently -k -n vite,electron -c cyan,green "npm run dev:renderer" "wait-on http://localhost:5290 && cross-env RENDERER_URL=http://localhost:5290 RELAY_HTTP=http://localhost:7177 RELAY_WS=ws://localhost:7177/ws electron ."
scripts.dev:cloud: concurrently -k -n vite,electron -c cyan,green "npm run dev:renderer" "wait-on http://localhost:5290 && cross-env RENDERER_URL=http://localhost:5290 RELAY_HTTP=https://dev.falloutchatmod.com RELAY_WS=wss://dev.falloutchatmod.com/ws electron ."

//scripts: DEVELOPMENT uses ONLY dev:local / start:local — both target your local backend at http://localhost:7076. dev:local is ONE command: starts the Vite renderer (HMR) + launches Electron against it (edit ChatOverlay.tsx/shell.ts → hot-reloads). start:local builds the renderer once (no HMR). dev:cloud is Path A (cloud dev): same HMR setup but RELAY_HTTP/RELAY_WS point at dev.falloutchatmod.com — the dev API/WS is exposed on a non-Cloudflare-Access path so only the normal install-token/session auth is needed (no CF headers). start + dist:* are the SHIPPING build of the end-user binary, which targets the production relay (https://falloutchatmod.com) — do NOT use them to develop against prod. NOTE: node_modules is platform-specific (native binaries: rollup, electron) — run these on the SAME OS you ran `npm install` on. On Windows+WSL, install and run the overlay on Windows.

linux.description: A transparent, always-on-top overlay for Fallout 76 community chat.
